findings.summary: 工具结果到证据统计契约不统一：12条证据全部降级，已验证结论为空。
causal_evidence: evidence_statistics.py reads run_python.result, while real sandbox outputs use output and often np scalar repr.
Nested statistical_details from real model do not populate root required fields. One unrecognized receipt disables descriptive-only required-field handling.
Real backend state has statistical_detail_status=missing; this does not demonstrate dropped SSE delivery.
findings.repair_scope: 建立统一的类型化计算结果/方法适用性投影；描述统计不强制推断字段，真实收据及会话归属校验保留。用本批实际参数和真实输出形状做离线回归。

_compact_tool_output also compacts read_file output; no bounded pagination contract for the long source detail.

findings.summary: 证据图失败后改用exploratory手工数据，最终正文及导出仍当作正式图表。

M06 prose incorrectly says cohort chart is evidence-bound. Export validates renderability, not publication/evidence eligibility; visible provenance JSON is not an explicit exploratory warning.
findings.repair_scope: 保留探索图能力，但发布与导出显示实际证据等级；正式结论图必须绑定计算结果及数据版本。

findings.summary: 单条回复导出依赖全文相等，实时文本与持久化投影不一致时被拒绝。
causal_evidence: Observed one HTTP400 unbound_reply, no download.
Backend assistant_replies already groups messages; the cause is not simply ungrouped backend segments.

Frontend sends turn.content; backend matches exact grouped text. Terminal publication replaces pending text events, discarding the round separator (loop.py:2539). This is a concrete mismatch mechanism; request payload was not retained for complete byte-for-byte reconstruction.
findings.repair_scope: 采用持久化回复身份进行导出归属，统一实时/恢复文本分段；保持跨会话拒绝，补多轮工具后最终回复测试。

findings.summary: 工具能力说明、参数类型及沙盒可执行子集不一致，模型多次纠错却难以收敛。
causal_evidence: M03 top_n receives string booleans/limits; derive np.select unsupported.
M05 invokes run_python 26 times and never ab_test; import, builtin and numpy repr restrictions trigger repeated errors.
M06 heatmap numeric-y contract and generated dataset loading failures induce chart fallback.
findings.repair_scope: 逐项核对模型可见schema、真实参数验证及支持的计算路径；优先配对检验原生工具，不扩大沙盒权限或以涨额度掩盖收敛问题。

findings.summary: 消费计数闭合正常，但达到验收上限的提示归因错误，服务优雅退出失败。
causal_evidence: 32 physical calls completed, 33rd logical attempt blocked locally; no unknown requests.
Run notice says provider_request_failed. Ledger/lifecycle closed but PID required verified forced termination.
Post-shutdown liveness root cause remains unproved; do not blame Provider.
findings.repair_scope: 区分验收限额、产品停止和Provider失败；在离线测试中审计所有线程/子进程关闭证明，不放宽额度或修改收据。

findings.repair_scope: 将分析单位、分母、时间窗口、检验方法、单位与论断边界纳入统一发布契约；正文、证据、图表及导出验证同一结果。

architecture_assessment.budget_and_counter: Acceptance caps and receipts bounded authorized spend and isolated M05. They did not cause evidence field mismatch, timestamp collisions, result-read recursion or generated-file lookup failure. Increasing caps would not repair these contracts. Product resource policy and external acceptance accounting must remain separate.
architecture_assessment.sse: Session ID, layout, disabled composer and observed restores improved. Empty verified conclusions correspond to durable missing-statistics state. M04 exposes a separate live/persisted text projection mismatch. No evidence supports calling every failure an SSE transport bug.
architecture_assessment.why_prior_tests_missed: 2497 offline tests and B07 scripted browser exercised configured data paths and selected model outputs. Real model emits nested statistical_details, output text with numpy repr, long read_file chains, several evidence records in one second, many intermediate assistant segments, unsupported sandbox operations and manual exploratory chart fallbacks. These behavior and composition cases were not covered by the prior green fixtures.
architecture_assessment.fix_strategy: Use shared contracts for result references, statistical evidence, immutable artifact identity and public reply/chart identity inside existing Route A. Preserve native tools, sandbox boundaries and evidence checks; do not create v2 or expand budgets to force green.

next_offline_work: Reproduce F01/F02/F03/F04/F06 from saved transcripts and artifacts with Provider disabled; implement minimal contract fixes.
Separate descriptive/inferential evidence requirements; prove chart/body/export bind the same result, denominator, window and unit.
Add sandbox/type feedback, native paired-test routing and shutdown regressions; retain fixed acceptance accounting semantics.
Run pytest tests in new isolated directory; run all six full zero-Provider real-browser journeys including refresh/switch/export/faults.
Freeze new source/input/oracle identity and seek fresh explicit authorization before any additional real Provider batch. A02 unused slots are not permission to continue.
